traffic.diagnostics: 資料點：{{points}} | 壓縮後：{{compressed}} | 影格率：{{fps}}

connection.needsActivation: 此裝置需要啟用碼才能連接。
connection.requiresSetup: Chrysalis 暫時無法開啟 VPN：它需要管理員權限，且尚未安裝 Chrysalis 服務。使用安裝程式安裝 Chrysalis 會自動完成設定。
connection.subscriptionLapsed: Your Chrysalis subscription has expired, so the VPN will not connect. Contact the person who sold you the code to renew it.
connection.subscriptionExpiresToday: Your Chrysalis subscription expires today. Contact the person who sold you the code to renew it.
connection.subscriptionExpiresIn: Your Chrysalis subscription expires in {{count}} days. Contact the person who sold you the code to renew it.

account.expiresSoon: Your subscription expires soon. Contact the person who sold you the code to renew.
account.noExpiryYet: Your subscription end date is not available yet. It will appear after this device next contacts Chrysalis.
account.activateForExpiry: Activate this device to see your subscription.
account.deviceIdHint: Quote the device ID if you need support — it identifies this install without revealing anything about you.
account.notActivated: This device is not activated. Enter the code from your card to connect.
account.notActivatedToCheck: Activate a code first — there is nothing to confirm yet.
account.hubBehind: Your Chrysalis server is running an older version of its account checks. If someone suspends your access, this device will not find out until the server is updated. Quote this number to them: {{hub}}.
account.refreshBusy: A status read was already running
account.storedCodeDamaged: The sign-in saved on this computer is damaged and could not be used, so Chrysalis is asking you to enter your code again. Your plan and its remaining time are not affected.
account.updateCheckOff: Automatic update checking is off, so Chrysalis is not being told about new versions. Turn it on above to receive fixes.
account.updateBlocked: Chrysalis cannot update itself right now: {{reason}}
account.probe.title: Check this device against the server
account.probe.intro: If you have been told you are signed out while this app says otherwise, run this check and quote the code it shows.
account.probe.livenessLive: The server heard from this device recently.
account.probe.livenessStale: The server has not heard from this device for a while. It may be off, offline, or the app may have been closed — the server cannot tell which.
account.probe.livenessAbsent: The server has not heard from this device for over a week.
account.probe.livenessUnknown: The server has no record of this device checking in yet, so it cannot say whether it is working. This is not the same as being signed out.

connection.takingLonger: Still connecting. This can take a few seconds on a school network — you can cancel and try again.
connection.metricsWhenConnected: Traffic figures appear once the VPN is on.
connection.blockerServiceInstallRequired: Chrysalis cannot turn the VPN on yet: its helper service is not installed, and the permission prompt to install it was dismissed, denied, or never appeared. Quit and reopen Chrysalis, then approve the prompt when it appears. If no prompt appears at all, reinstall Chrysalis, then approve the prompt.
connection.blockerServiceUnavailable: Chrysalis cannot turn the VPN on yet: its helper service is installed but not working ({{reason}}). Quit and reopen Chrysalis to repair it. If that does not work, reinstall Chrysalis.
connection.blockerServiceOperationInFlight: Chrysalis is setting up its helper service. This takes a moment — wait for the prompt or for this message to clear, then try again.
connection.toggleHint: Press Enter to turn the VPN on or off

supportBlock.title: Any problem at all — email us.
supportBlock.middleman: Start with the person who sold you your code: they know your account and can usually fix it on the spot.
supportBlock.emailLead: If they cannot, or you bought your code yourself, email
supportBlock.emailNote: and describe the problem: what you were doing, the exact message the app showed, and the Device ID from your Account page. Short is fine — the message is the part that matters.
supportBlock.replyPromise: Every email is answered within 12 hours, not counting nighttime.
supportBlock.why: Chrysalis is run by one person, so an email that names the error is something that can actually be fixed.
supportBlock.deviceIdHint: Include the Device ID from your Account page — it is the one thing that tells us which install you are using.

signOut.title: Signed in on this device
signOut.body: Signing out makes this computer forget your access key. Your subscription is not cancelled, and the time you have paid for keeps running.
signOut.confirmBody: Chrysalis will forget your access key on this computer. This computer will stop working with Chrysalis until you enter the key from your card again.
signOut.confirmMoving: If you are moving to a new computer, this is what you want.
signOut.confirmKeeps: Your subscription is not cancelled, and it will not be shortened.
signOut.signedOut: Signed out. This computer no longer holds your key.
signOut.signedOutReleased: Signed out. Your key has been released here and is ready for your next device.
signOut.signedOutOffline: [en] Signed out on this computer. We could not reach Chrysalis to record it, so this key will be refused on another computer until it is released here. Entering it again on THIS computer works; if this computer is going away, email us and we will release the key.
signOut.signedOutFailed: Chrysalis could not sign out. Nothing has changed on this device. Try again, and email us if it keeps happening.
signOut.deviceIdCopyFailed: Could not copy automatically — select the Device ID and copy it by hand.

connection.freeDataNearlyOut: {{used}} of {{total}} used — nearly out of free data
connection.freeDataThrottled: {{used}} of {{total}} used — free data is spent for this month
connection.freeDataThrottledUpgrade: Full is faster and unmetered. Ask the person who sold you your code about upgrading.

activation.title: 輸入您的代碼
activation.lede: 您的代碼在購買時拿到的卡片上。
activation.backupRoute: 正在使用 Chrysalis 備援路徑連線至伺服器。
activation.alphabet: 代碼為 15 個字元，絕不包含 0、O、1 或 I。

suspended.lapsedBody: 您的代碼已過期，因此連線已停止。向出售代碼給您的人續訂即可恢復存取。
suspended.suspendedBody: 營運人員已暫停此代碼，因此連線已停止。您的代碼仍儲存在這台電腦上。
suspended.lapsedAction: 請聯絡出售代碼給您的人進行續訂。
suspended.suspendedAction: 請對方解除暫停。您無須重新輸入代碼或重新啟動應用程式即可再次連線。
